_comment: Golden set for agent-preflight.py — the versioned contract that the code-intelligence / RAG surface must satisfy before an agent trusts it. Edit deliberately: a golden that stops resolving is a REGRESSION signal, not a reason to weaken the check.

known_cli_only._comment: Tools that are registered but NOT exposed over MCP (mcp_surface.rs MCP_TOOLS_RETIRED). Agents reaching the MCP surface cannot call these; the preflight WARNs so the gap stays visible. `code_search` was restored to MCP 2026-07-22 and is no longer here.

continuity._comment: Session-continuity stack (frames, split protocol, distill guard). Local checks catch binary/hook skew on THIS machine; `peers` are same-mesh daemons verified remotely over read-only HTTP (:9741) — unreachable is WARN, reachable-but-stale is FAIL. Add --peer <host> for ad-hoc checks, --no-peers to skip.

golden._comment: Round-trips that must return real answers on this repo. Stable, load-bearing names chosen so a miss means the index/store regressed, not that the code changed.
